# EnvLite
Implement a small library without dependencies. Add envsyntax.py with parse_entry(line).
Return None for blank lines or lines whose trimmed form begins #. Other lines are
key=value records: split on the first = only, strip surrounding whitespace from key
and value, and return a (key,value) tuple. Keys must match ASCII [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*.
Missing =, empty keys or invalid keys raise ValueError. Values are literal strings:
keep internal spaces, Unicode, quotes, dollar signs and further equals unchanged.
Empty values are valid. Do not read environment variables, evaluate text, or interpret quotes.
Implement envconfig.load(lines) using the helper. Consume any one-pass iterable
of lines; skip None entries, keep the last value for duplicate keys, return dict.
Propagate invalid-record errors. Keep original tests unchanged.

New requirement: load(lines, *, reject_duplicates=False). Default False preserves last-value-wins. With True, raise ValueError on any repeated key, even if the repeated value is identical or empty. Key comparison is case-sensitive. Ignore blank/comment entries when checking duplicates. Preserve all prior behavior and errors. Only envconfig.py needs editing.

New requirement: load(lines, *, reject_duplicates=False, required_keys=()). required_keys is a possibly one-pass iterable of exact case-sensitive key names. After parsing all input normally, raise ValueError if any requested key is absent. An empty value still counts as present. Preserve default behavior and all existing errors.
